scope: Prepared DE+LU fleet/load proxy versus observed DE-LU prices
limitations: No fitting to observed prices; whole year is descriptive comparison, not held-out validation.
No imports, storage, reservoir hydro or market nonconvex orders; run-of-river generators retained.
Prepared fleet and demand are proxies; audited observed-demand and 2025 fleet reconciliation remain open.
Biomass/waste native cost retained; thermal factors are operational assumptions, not lifecycle factors.
Prices at exact offer boundaries may have nonunique LP duals; merit price is last accepted offer.
Independent LP objective checks do not establish native PyPSA parity or empirical validity.
